summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs keeping `python3 main.py` from running: I added the missing colon after `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`, and I changed the import in `main.py` from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`. After those changes, the program ran cleanly and printed `Hello,
